body.deadline_description: Final pay on involuntary termination: Compensation for labor earned, vested, determinable, and unpaid at discharge is due immediately (CRS § 8-4-109). If payroll department is not operational or accessible on the day of discharge, wages are due within 6 hours of the next business day's start. If wages remain unclaimed after 60 days, employer must mail to employee's last-known address. Willful violation can result in treble damages; automatic penalties can double wages owed.
